data:
传说有位死魂灵附身于某处古老的移动地块之上，至今游荡在大地某处。你眼前的会是那个地块吗？上面生活着怎样的居民？
<@rolv.rem>场地中有产生食腐使徒的<汲营枯枝></>

あるレヴァナントがどこかの古い移動区画に憑依して、今も大地を彷徨っているという伝説がある。もしや、あなたの目の前にある区画がそうなのだろうか？だとすれば、そこには一体どんな人たちが住んでいるのだろう？
<@rolv.rem>ナハツェーラーの使徒を産み出す<渇欲の枯枝>が出現</>

Legends say a revenant has possessed an ancient nomadic plate and wanders the land to this day. Could it be this very plate before you? What kind of people live on it?
<@rolv.rem><Twigs That Crave> that produce Rot Eaters are present on the field</>
所有敌方单位的攻击力+30%，生命值+50%
All enemy units have +30% ATK and +50% Max HP
ナハツェーラーの使徒
More likely to be attacked; once defeated, drops 1 Plan
Creates Mark of Epoch in the surrounding area; allied units within the Mark of Epoch receive continuous Necrosis damage
Releases [Corruption], causing your units to lose HP over time. Deals {ba.dt.apoptosis} around itself when HP drops to 50%.
Gives +4 Originium Ingots when fully healed
